name: Overture 3D Technologies, LLC
summary: US-based consumer filament brand founded in 2019 and headquartered in Houston, Texas. Overture is an importer/brand rather than a factory: its filament is manufactured by Polymaker (project-owner verified), so the material itself originates in China. Best known as a high-volume Amazon budget/mid brand with a broad PLA aesthetic range.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). No public statement from either company was found to corroborate or deny this; treated as owner-authoritative but not independently confirmed via open web.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Pure PLA homopolymer, no filler. TDS: density 1.21 g/cm3 (ISO 1183), Vicat 64.2 C (ISO 306), XY tensile 47.1 +/- 1.2 MPa (ISO 527).

product_lines.name: PLA Refill / Easy PLA / PLA 2Kg / PLA 3Kg
product_lines.notes: Same base PLA formulation as the standard PLA; packaging/spool-size variants only, not a distinct chemistry.

product_lines.name: PLA+ (PLA Plus)
product_lines.notes: PLA with an impact-toughening additive ('Stronger & More Durable, Professional Toughness').

product_lines.name: Super PLA+
product_lines.notes: Further toughness-enhanced PLA+ formulation; same modifier category as PLA+, marketed one step above it.

product_lines.name: PLA Professional (PLA Pro)
product_lines.notes: High-toughness PLA grade marketed as distinct from PLA+; chemically still an impact-modified PLA, so it shares the pla-plus id. Relative modifier loading vs PLA+/Super PLA+ is not published.

product_lines.name: Rock PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA with a stone/mineral filler ('stone-filled composite'). Base resin is PLA; the catalog has no stone/marble-filled PLA id, so only the base id is asserted (see gaps).

product_lines.name: Shimmer PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA with glitter/sparkle particulate. Base resin is PLA; no glitter-PLA id exists in the catalog (see gaps).

product_lines.name: Gradient series (PLA Gradient, Matte PLA Gradient, PLA Pro Gradient, Silk PLA Gradient, Rock PLA Gradient)
product_lines.notes: Colour-graded spools of the chemistries already listed above rather than a separate formulation; each variant keeps its base chemistry's id in addition to pla-gradient.

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: Pure PETG. TDS: density 1.30 g/cm3, Vicat 75 C, XY tensile 47.9 +/- 4.8 MPa. A High Speed grade is sold on the same resin.

product_lines.name: TPU 95A / High Speed TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A (ISO 7619), density 1.18 g/cm3, tensile 30.1 MPa, elongation at break 332% +/- 16%. Also sold in 2 kg spools.

product_lines.name: ABS
product_lines.notes: 'Specialty ABS resin' formulated for lower VOC/odour. Density 1.15 g/cm3, Vicat 103.4 C, XY tensile 25.1 MPa.

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Weather-resistant ABS alternative. Density 1.14 g/cm3, Vicat 106.2 C, XY tensile 45.1 MPa.

product_lines.name: Easy Nylon
product_lines.notes: Unfilled PA6/PA66 copolymer, so it maps to the generic pa id rather than pa6 or pa66. Vicat 181.2 C, elongation 8.4%, drying 95 C / 7 h. Remapped pa→copa (copolyamide) 2026-08-01.

product_lines.name: PC Professional
product_lines.notes: Polycarbonate; the page does not disclose whether it is neat PC or a blend, so pc-abs is not asserted. Print 250-270 C, thermal stability quoted to 110 C.

additional_notes: Registered as Overture 3D Technologies, LLC (10777 Westheimer Rd Ste 159, Houston, TX 77042) per USPTO trademark records. No sub-brands known. Spool pricing runs roughly $11.69-$32.99 with standard 1 kg PLA typically $15-20, placing it on the budget/mid boundary; heavy bundle and discount promotion is characteristic of the brand. No build plates or print surfaces were found on the official store, but this is an unverified negative so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: The Polymaker manufacturing relationship is owner-verified but has no public corroboration or denial; manufacturing_countries is derived entirely from that relationship rather than from any Overture statement of origin.
